Researcher Matthew Johnson joins Danny Jones to talk about a new test that uses religious drugs to try to bring God back. Johnson works on DMT and the strange worlds it opens. The test at issue gives the drug in slow, long doses.

Johnson explains how the test is run and what the subjects report at the peak. He asks whether the shared world they find could be a real place where God can be met. Jones presses on faith, fraud, and proof. Listeners get the science and the wonder in one talk. The library files it as an archive record.
